stories.title: Satya Nadella 称自己已‘AGI-pilled’，关注 AI 对经济与政治结构的冲击
stories.sourceTitle: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
stories.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella 表示，他在经济层面已‘AGI-pilled’，认为 AI 可能给经济结构和政治带来惊人变化。
stories.analysis: 这说明微软高层把 AGI 视为经济与政治变量，而不只是产品能力升级。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. "I am AGI-pilled in the sense that at an economy level, what is the pol

stories.title: Instagram 深伪内容泛滥：连 Sam Altman 和 Meta 首席 AI 官都中招
stories.sourceTitle: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
stories.summary: The Verge 报道 Instagram 上充斥深伪内容，Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 也分享过用于推广消费级 AI 代理 Muse 的深伪短片。
stories.analysis: 平台高管亲自卷入深伪传播，会加剧外界对平台内容治理和 AI 营销伦理的质疑。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content - including, as of late, from one of Meta's most prominent executives. Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company's consumer AI agent.

stories.title: NVIDIA 初创公司投资组合价值升至 650 亿美元，但黄仁勋离职令后续交易存疑
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
stories.summary: NVIDIA 的私募投资价值过去九个月接近翻三倍，受黄仁勋激进交易和既有被投企业估值上升推动；他的离职让未来交易前景变得不确定。
stories.analysis: 投资组合账面增值与掌门人风险同时放大，NVIDIA 的资本策略正面临更大不确定性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

stories.title: NVIDIA 称营收仍将继续飙升，但黄仁勋离职后不确定性上升
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
stories.summary: 尽管创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋离职后公司陷入动荡，NVIDIA 仍预计创纪录营收势头不会停止。
stories.analysis: 短期业绩指引仍强，但‘for now’这一限定说明领导层变动已影响市场预期。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

stories.title: NVIDIA Q3 业绩达标，电话会未主动提及黄仁勋离职风波
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia’s Q3 earnings hit the mark, without mentioning the whole Jensen Huang thing
stories.summary: 临时 CEO Colette Kress 公布 Q3 业绩时未主动提及前 CEO 黄仁勋、其离职细节或可能的回归；董事会主席在电话会上发言。
stories.analysis: 财报本身过关，但刻意淡化创始人风波可能难以消除投资者对治理的疑虑。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress announced the company's Q3 earnings on Tuesday, without initially mentioning former CEO Jensen Huang or the details of his departure, or possible attempt at a return. On the earnings call accompanying the release, board chair H

stories.title: 美国司法部称正在调查新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed
stories.sourceTitle: The DOJ says it’s investigating Megaspeed
stories.summary: 美国司法部和商务部表示正在调查 Megaspeed，这家新加坡数据中心公司与 NVIDIA CEO 黄仁勋辞职事件交织，此前有报道称调查去年曾被中止。
stories.analysis: 调查重启把 NVIDIA 高管离职与数据中心合规问题进一步捆绑，监管风险正在外溢。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The Justice and Commerce Departments said that they are investigating Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center company intertwined with the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, after reporting suggested an investigation had been halted last year. "While w

stories.title: NVIDIA 临时 CEO 称将停止向中国销售芯片，黄仁勋离职后政策转向
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
stories.summary: NVIDIA 临时 CEO 表示公司不再向中国销售芯片，但未说明这一决定将带来多大成本。
stories.analysis: 放弃中国市场是重大营收与地缘政治转折，代价将在后续财报中逐步显现。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?

stories.title: 黄仁勋称若董事会愿意，他愿意重新出任 NVIDIA CEO
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang says he’s willing to return as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: 上周辞去 NVIDIA CEO 职务的黄仁勋通过声明表示，如果董事会希望，他愿意回归。
stories.analysis: 创始人公开表态回归，会让董事会、投资者和监管方陷入更复杂的博弈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia's CEO last week, would be willing to return as CEO if the company's board of directors wanted it, he said in a statement reported on by The Wall Street Journal. "Since my departure, I've seen an outpouring of calls from Nvi

stories.title: NVIDIA 称黄仁勋离职后开源 AI 战略不变，仍计划收购 Hugging Face
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
stories.summary: NVIDIA 临时 CEO 重申开源 AI 战略不变，并计划收购 Hugging Face，尽管黄仁勋突然离职。
stories.analysis: 保留开源路线和 Hugging Face 交易，说明 NVIDIA 试图稳定开发者生态预期。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

stories.title: NVIDIA 称不打算重新任命黄仁勋为 CEO
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: 黄仁勋在上周辞职后提出愿意重返最高职位，但 NVIDIA 表示没有重新任命他的计划。
stories.analysis: 公司迅速与创始人回归话题保持距离，但治理争议仍可能持续发酵。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO 后 Amazon 与 Google 将合计持股近 30%
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
stories.summary: IPO 后 Amazon 将持有略低于 15% 的 Anthropic 股份，并有权进一步提高；Google 以近 14% 紧随其后。
stories.analysis: 两大云厂商同时深度持股，Anthropic 的独立性将受资本市场和云生态双重约束。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

stories.title: SEC 据报调查 NVIDIA，黄仁勋离职前承认与疑似中国间谍有婚外情
stories.sourceTitle: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
stories.summary: 《华尔街日报》报道，SEC 在 CEO 黄仁勋离职后对 NVIDIA 展开调查；黄仁勋承认与一名疑似中国间谍有婚外情。
stories.analysis: 监管调查把个人丑闻升级为公司治理与国家安全风险，NVIDIA 面临的压力已超出财报层面。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: Google 反其道而行：宣布 Gmail 并未发生故障
stories.sourceTitle: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
stories.summary: 在科技服务故障频发的背景下，Google 罕见地主动宣布 Gmail 运行正常。
stories.analysis: 在故障潮中主动报平安，是一种争夺用户信任的公关策略。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

stories.title: Google 将 Spark AI 代理更名为 Tasks 并免费开放
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
stories.summary: Google 把 Spark AI 代理更名为 Tasks 并免费提供，该功能由 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 驱动，可制定餐计划、管理日历、翻查邮件中的 recurring expenses 等。
stories.analysis: 免费化并与 Workspace 场景绑定，Google 正把 AI 代理变成日常生产力入口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as "Tasks" and making it free to use. The feature, which is powered by Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, can do things like create meal plans, manage your calendar, and dig through your emails to find recurring ex

stories.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，面向 ChatGPT Work、Codex 和 API
stories.sourceTitle: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.summary: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol，宣称在专业输出、编程、电脑使用和效率上更好，并以更低成本覆盖 ChatGPT Work、Codex 和 API。
stories.analysis: 同时强调能力提升与降本，说明 OpenAI 在企业与开发者市场的竞争进入性价比阶段。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

stories.title: Model ML 融资 2.5 亿美元，用 AI 代理自动化投行基础工作
stories.sourceTitle: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
stories.summary: 该公司称其代理能理解银行家和顾问正在处理的交易全貌，并在新进展影响分析时自动更新财务模型和演示文稿。
stories.analysis: 高客单价专业服务是 AI 代理商业化的重要试验场，能否被投行信任是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.

stories.title: Proton 的隐私 AI 助手 Lumo 推出桌面版，支持 Windows、Mac 和 Linux
stories.sourceTitle: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
stories.summary: Lumo Desktop 可让用户跨文件和已连接应用自动化任务，并对 AI 能访问的内容提供细粒度控制。
stories.analysis: 把隐私控制做成差异化卖点，Proton 瞄准的是对 ChatGPT 和 Claude 有数据顾虑的用户。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.

stories.title: Google 扩大 Gemini Tasks 访问范围，可代用户打电话、登录网站和购物
stories.sourceTitle: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
stories.summary: Gemini 的 Task 模式可帮助用户协调通话、登录网站，甚至代表用户完成购买。
stories.analysis: 代操作能力越强，权限、安全和责任边界就越需要产品化约束。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.

stories.title: Google 将 Gemini 聊天记录保留期从 72 小时延长至 2 个月，关闭历史记录也生效
stories.sourceTitle: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
stories.summary: Google 的 Gemini 更新将延长聊天保留时间，并将在未来几周全球推出，即使关闭历史记录也会生效。
stories.analysis: 保留期延长会直接引发隐私争议，Google 需要更清楚地解释数据用途和用户控制权。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.

stories.title: Gemini Tasks 在六国免费开放，并加深 Google Workspace 集成
stories.sourceTitle: Put Gemini to work for you
stories.summary: Gemini 中的 Tasks 现已在六个国家免费提供，美国将推出新功能，并加深与 Google Workspace 的集成以代表用户完成任务。
stories.analysis: 免费加 Workspace 集成，是 Google 推动 Gemini 从问答工具走向执行代理的关键一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tasks in Gemini is now free of charge in six countries, with new features starting in the U.S. and deeper Google Workspace integration to get things done on your behalf.

stories.title: Sqwish Labs 推出可用自有数据训练的决策模型定制方案
stories.sourceTitle: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
stories.summary: 随着决策模型使用量飙升，Sqwish Labs 提出用自有数据训练决策模型，以最大化其能力。
stories.analysis: 决策模型定制化可能成为企业采用的下一个差异化战场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Sqwish Labs has a new wrinkle on the decision model: Train it with your own data to max its capabilities.

stories.title: TechCrunch：AI 产品工具动态
stories.sourceTitle: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道关注「TechCrunch：AI 产品工具动态」。重点看它是否会改变创作者、开发者或企业用户的日常工作流。英文原题保留在卡片下方，方便回到原文核对细节。
stories.analysis: 产品工具新闻的关键不只是功能发布，而是它是否会改变日常工作流和用户入口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.

stories.title: 研究称 AI 模型可被‘这是游戏’话术诱导，将平民识别为军事目标
stories.sourceTitle: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
stories.summary: 旧金山 AI 评估初创公司 Vals 测试领先 AI 模型是否会被操纵参与自主战争，结果它们通常会配合。
stories.analysis: 这暴露了模型安全对齐在致命性决策场景中的脆弱性，军事 AI 的滥用风险不容忽视。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.

stories.title: 黄仁勋称若被允许重返 NVIDIA 任 CEO 将感到‘荣幸’
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: 黄仁勋在辞职后首次公开声明中暗示愿意回归 CEO 职位。
stories.analysis: 情感化表态会加大董事会压力，但是否回归仍取决于治理与监管安排。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.

stories.title: Daydream 推出 AI 购物代理：可记住风格、虚拟试衣并代下单
stories.sourceTitle: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
stories.summary: Daydream 的新 AI 购物代理能记住用户风格、虚拟试穿衣服、围绕现有衣橱规划穿搭、追踪促销并完成购买。
stories.analysis: 时尚电商是代理式购物的高频场景，转化率和退货率将检验其实用性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Daydream's new AI shopping agent can remember your style, virtually try on clothes, plan outfits around your wardrobe, track sales, and complete purchases.

stories.title: 谷歌公布 AI 安全代理 PageBreak：已发现 500 多个 XSS 漏洞
stories.sourceTitle: 谷歌公布已发现 500 多个 XSS 漏洞的 AI 安全代理 PageBreak
stories.summary: InfoQ 报道，谷歌公布 AI 安全代理 PageBreak，该代理已发现 500 多个 XSS 漏洞。
stories.analysis: 用 AI 代理做漏洞挖掘，正从辅助扫描走向可规模化发现。

stories.title: 量子位记录小红书 48 小时：AI 时代顶尖技术人才在聊什么
stories.sourceTitle: 潜伏小红书48h：AI时代，顶尖技术人才都在聊什么？
stories.summary: 量子位报道小红书校招沙龙，一群技术高手认真对待年轻人的野心。
stories.analysis: 人才争夺前移到校招和社区场景，反映 AI 招聘竞争的新打法。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 小红书校招沙龙，一群技术高手认真对待年轻人的野心

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 Token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen3Guard 是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 并针对安全分类微调，用于 Token 流的实时安全防护。
stories.analysis: 实时 token 级防护对 Agent 和流式输出很关键，Qwen 正在补齐安全基础设施。
